messages:
maria: Heads up — sample-app CI is failing on the release branch after the latest typegen regen.

devon: saw that. failure looks like a runtime type mismatch for AuthRetry config.

jen: any error logs?

ci-bot: build 4821 failed on job 'integration:sdk-sample'.

ci-bot: ```
Error: TypeError: missing property 'retryBackoff' in AuthRetryOptions
    at validateAuthRetry (/workspace/sdk/dist/auth.js:42:15)
    at Object.init (/workspace/sample-app/src/start.js:12:7)
    at processImmediate (internal/timers.js:456:21)
```

typegen-bot: regen diff summary: 1 file changed (packages/typegen/lib/auth.d.ts). Changed: AuthRetryOptions added optional field 'retryBackoffMs?: number' and renamed 'maxAttempts' -> 'maxRetries' (breaking).

maria: oh — breaking rename slipped into typegen without semver bump. The published SDKs are still expecting maxAttempts.

devon: where did the rename come from? I thought we kept API stable.

sam: I pushed a quick typegen patch yesterday to reflect upstream spec. Must've introduced rename while trying to normalize names.

jen: CI for sample-app consumes released JS SDK from registry, not local workspace — so mismatch between published SDK and regenerated types in repo.

maria: we need to either revert the breaking rename in typegen or publish a new major/patch with compat shim. The automated release pipeline didn't catch a semver bump requirement.

devon: also the changelog generator relies on commit message format. This change was small and landed with 'feat(typegen): rename maxAttempts' which should have triggered a major? Our semver rules are fuzzy for typegen-only changes.

sam: I can put up a fix: add back compat alias in runtime (keep maxAttempts mapped to maxRetries) and publish a patch. Then we can follow up with a proper API deprecation plan.

maria: patch + compat shim seems fastest to unbreak customers. But we should also update CI to run a quick sample-app smoke test against _new_ typegen outputs before merging releases.

jen: agree. Add a pre-release job: after generating types, run 'packages/sample-app yarn test:smoke' in CI. Fails fast.

typegen-bot: suggested command to reproduce locally: `yarn workspace @redwood/typegen run regen && yarn workspace sample-app test:smoke`

devon: quick local repro showed the alias fix works. here's the shim I used:

sam: ```js
// packages/sdk/src/auth.js
function normalizeAuthOptions(opts) {
  if (opts.maxAttempts !== undefined && opts.maxRetries === undefined) {
    opts.maxRetries = opts.maxAttempts;
  }
  return opts;
}
exports.init = (opts) => initBase(normalizeAuthOptions(opts));
```

maria: please open a PR with that shim + changelog entry and mark it urgent. Also create a follow-up ticket to tighten semver rules for typegen changes.

sam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1124 — contains shim, tests, and changelog patch. CI currently running.

ci-bot: PR 1124: build passing, tests passing, merging in 10m if no objections.

devon: after merge, I'll trigger a full publish of the JS SDK (patch) and then re-run sample-app CI.

jen: can we also add a GH action to run sample-app against the published package on every release? Might catch this earlier.

maria: yes — add a 'post-release verification' step that installs the published tarball and runs smoke tests.

sam: will follow up. also filing ticket DEVEX-289: "enforce sample-app smoke test on typegen/regeneration" assigned to devex squad.

maria: thanks everyone — good catch from CI. :thumbsup:

devon: note: we should also update the typegen README to include a checklist: known-breaking-change gating, semver note, sample-app smoke run.

jen: I'll add the checklist to the PR docs. closing loop once publish completes.

maria: last note — let's add an automerged label to any typegen-only change that renames public fields so it can't land without manual review.

sam: noted. I'll add the label rule in CODEOWNERS/PR templates.

ci-bot: sample-app pipeline re-run scheduled (job 4822).
